title: GlobalFoundries plans to build two "essential chip" plants in Malta, New York, backed by up to $21B from Japan; the US will take a 4% stake in GlobalFoundries (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: GlobalFoundries plans to build two “essential chip” plants in Malta, New York, backed by up to $21B from Japan; the US will take a 4% stake in GlobalFoundries — GlobalFoundries Inc. plans to build two new chip plants with the backing of as much as $21 billion from the Japanese government …
